Hi Lucas/Priya — following the demo and materials, a few clarifications from the security side:

- Pen test: the attached pen_test_summary_2026-11.pdf covers high/medium findings, remediation status, and we maintain an internal ticket backlog for any open items. Full findings (raw) are available under NDA or in our secure portal.
- Audit logs: we provide structured admin and API audit logs with the following minimal fields: timestamp, actor_id (anonymized in sample), action, resource, request_id, outcome. Retention: default retention is 13 months for audit logs; longer retention can be configured for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Data retention & deletion: data_retention_policy.txt outlines typical retention windows (logs 13 months, ephemeral KV/cache <24 hours by default, user-created artifacts configurable). We support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for encryption at rest; details in SOC2.

If NovaCorp needs longer log retention or a specific SLA around log exports, we can propose a config and add it as a term in the Dedicated reservation or Private deployment addendum.

Attachments included:
- SOC2_report_2026-12.pdf
- pen_test_summary_2026-11.pdf
- audit_logs_sample_anon.csv
- data_retention_policy.txt

LMK if you want me to join your procurement call or provide a short writeup for legal on scope of SOC2 coverage and encryption.
